name: The Dali EDITION
positioning: EDITION hotel in Dali, Yunnan, with Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake views, a charcoal robata restaurant and a spa using native ingredients
best_for: Travelers who want mountain and lake views in Dali
Guests who value spa and wellness facilities and a pool

facts.text: Rooms have views of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake.
Room design reflects the spirit of Dali and its natural surroundings.
The suites use warm timber and natural tones, with day-lit living areas.
KUSHO serves Japanese flavors cooked over wood-fired charcoal, with robata-grilled dishes.
KUSHO grills over local aromatic hardwoods.
MARKET at EDITION cooks with seasonal, sustainable and locally sourced ingredients from Yunnan and neighboring areas.
Spa treatments use mineral salts, seasonal blossoms and selected botanicals.
The gym has floor-to-ceiling windows and a dedicated studio for yoga or stretching.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
A vitality pool, sauna, steam room and rain shower sit alongside the indoor pool.
High-speed wireless internet is complimentary throughout the hotel.
Complimentary parking is available for in-house guests.

highlights.text: KUSHO grills over local aromatic hardwoods.
Rooms have views of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake.
The spa uses seasonal native ingredients such as pines and blooms from Cangshan Mountain.
MARKET at EDITION cooks with seasonal, sustainable and locally sourced ingredients from Yunnan and neighboring areas.

considerations.text: The drive from Dali Fengyi Airport by private transfer takes approximately 70 minutes.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is a remote destination that requires long-haul travel.
